$comment: Blueprints and builder NPCs (WORK_QUEUE item 55, docs/BLUEPRINTS.md): a placed structure shown as ghost blocks, built by players holding Place and by builder NPCs. `limits`: the most blueprints a world holds (`perWorld`). `player`: one piece every `paceMs` while Place is held aiming into a blueprint, the panel's most block rows (`panelRows`). `ghost`: the most ghost faces drawn per blueprint (`faceCap`). `builder`: the creature that builds (`creature`, shared/creatures), one piece every `paceS` seconds with unlimited blocks, standing within `reachM` of its cell to place it, spawned at a blueprint with a player within `nearM` m and none of its builders yet (at most `perBlueprint`). `catalog`: the repository's blueprints offered in the Blueprints list (structure names, shared/structures). Run `node shared/blueprints/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/blueprints.gen.rs is stale.
